@@U00128@@
concocting a ragout from other men’s feasts,
blowing paltry flames from your pile of ashes.
It will win you the applause of children and fools,
if that’s to your taste.
But you'll never move men’s hearts or unite them
unless it comes straight from your own heart.

@@U00130@@
Yes, but it’s the delivery that counts;
and believe me, I know how much I’ve still to learn.

@@U00132@@
Make an honest living.
Don’ go around a fool with bells tinkling.
Good sense and an honest message speak for themselves
without much art. If you're really serious,
and have something to say,
what need is there to hunt for words?
You and those dazzling speeches of yours,
crammed with bits and pieces from everywhere,
are about as refreshing as the foggy autumn wind
rustling dry leaves.

@@U00134@@
O God!
Art is so long and life so short!
There are times in my studies
when my heart sinks with any confidence
I once had. So much to master
to work your way up to the sources!
And before we're even halfway there
were dead, poor devils.

@@U00136@@
Your manuscript!
Is that the holy fountain
that will quench your thirst forever?
You'll never know refreshment
till it hows from deep within you.
translation:
@@U00128@@
用别人的盛宴调制炖菜，
从你的骨灰堆中吹出微弱的火焰。
它将为你赢得孩子们和傻瓜们的掌声，
如果那符合你的口味。
但你永远无法打动人们的心或团结他们
除非它直接来自你自己的内心。

@@U00130@@
是的，但重要的是交付；
相信我，我知道我还有很多东西需要学习。

@@U00132@@
诚实地生活。
不要绕着一个铃铛叮当作响的傻瓜走。
良好的判断力和诚实的信息不言而喻
没有太多的艺术。如果你真的是认真的
并有话要说，
有什么必要去寻找词语呢？
你和你那些令人眼花缭乱的演讲，
塞满了来自各地的零碎物品，
大约像雾蒙蒙的秋风一样清爽
干树叶沙沙作响。

@@U00134@@
上帝啊！
艺术如此漫长，生命如此短暂！
在我的学习中也有这样的时候
当我的心充满信心地沉沦时
我曾经有过。需要掌握的东西太多了
努力找到源头！
在我们完成一半之前
我们死了，可怜的魔鬼。

@@U00136@@
你的手稿！
这就是圣泉吗
那会永远解你的干渴吗？
你永远不会知道茶点
直到它从你内心深处发出来。
